Harvesting has a minimum charge per contractor visit (€2500.00 in this scenario). All felling approved for the same year shares one visit, so one visit costs less per tree than several small visits in different years. Planting, pruning and clearance are charged by time, with no minimum.
You could spend €5229.15 more before expected cash falls below one harvesting visit.

The residual stand: the trees left standing if all open work is carried out. An estimate before this year's growth; Annual Review shows what actually happened. Basal area is the cross-section area of the trunks per hectare, a standard measure of how much stand there is.
Spread out: no part of the stand is heavily opened.

The Work Plan collects your marks and planting spots into jobs you can review and approve. Check each cost, then approve the plan. Approval alone changes nothing: Advance one year carries out the approved jobs, and jobs you have not approved wait.
